source_notes:
**Franchise:** Star Wars  
**Strategy:** Swarm · **Target roster:** 11 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `geonosis-droid-foundry`

**Proposed robots:** Kalani; B1 battle droid; B2 super battle droid; Droideka; BX commando droid; IG-100 MagnaGuard; T-series tactical droid; B1 commander; dwarf spider droid; LM-432 crab droid; Octuptarra droid.

**Identity:** a surviving Separatist production line repurposes its machines for the arena. The stable expands through recognizable classes rather than eleven recoloured infantry portraits.

**Strategy personality:** prioritize roster growth and practical equipment. Light infantry, ranged platforms, and close-combat specialists give the army different build focuses within the existing Swarm strategy. Kalani supplies the stable's narrative leadership; he does not grant a new command buff.

| Slot | Proposed robot name | Source identity | Arena role direction | Portrait identity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Kalani** | Named Super Tactical Droid | Tactical ranged lead | Distinctive angular command head and source paint scheme. |
| 2 | **B1 Battle Droid 02** | Standard B1 battle droid | Light ranged infantry | Sand-coloured narrow chassis, elongated head, backpack, recognizable blaster. |
| 3 | **B2 Super Battle Droid 03** | B2 super battle droid | Durable ranged infantry | Broad blue-grey torso, recessed head, integrated forearm weapon. |
| 4 | **Droideka 04** | Destroyer droid | Defensive ranged platform | Deployed three-legged silhouette and twin weapon arms; keep the full body readable. |
| 5 | **BX Commando Droid 05** | BX-series commando droid | Mobile ranged specialist | Dark, agile humanoid chassis and distinctive commando head. |
| 6 | **IG-100 MagnaGuard 06** | MagnaGuard bodyguard droid | Close-combat specialist | Cloaked mechanical body and a clearly readable electrostaff. |
| 7 | **T-series Tactical Droid 07** | T-series tactical droid | Precise tactical fighter | Clearly different head and torso from Kalani; preserve the selected source unit's colours. |
| 8 | **B1 Commander 08** | B1 command variant | Light tactical infantry | The B1 source frame with command markings and a distinct pose. |
| 9 | **Dwarf Spider Droid 09** | Dwarf spider droid | Compact ranged platform | Four-legged domed chassis with a central cannon. |
| 10 | **LM-432 Crab Droid 10** | LM-432 “Muckraker” crab droid | Heavy close-range pressure | Select one source size/model and preserve its correct leg count and low stance. |
| 11 | **Octuptarra Droid 11** | Octuptarra droid | Heavy ranged platform | Select a smaller source variant; three tall legs and the characteristic elevated sensor/weapon body. |

The numbered names are original arena unit labels for source machine classes. They are not presented as named Star Wars characters. Only the two B1 entries deliberately share their basic chassis; the eleven portraits cover ten distinct chassis families.

**Visual family:** source-specific finishes, scuffed industrial metal, visible mechanisms, and subtle Geonosian factory atmosphere. Preserve the B1's thin geometry, the B2's broad mass, and the walker silhouettes. Shared lighting should unify the collection without forcing every machine into the same colour palette.

**Source edition:** use the established prequel/Clone Wars machine designs, with Kalani based on his Star Wars Rebels appearance. This is an era-spanning Separatist arena collection, not a claim that these exact units fought together in one battle.

References: [B1 battle droid](https://www.starwars.com/databank/battle-droid), [B2 super battle droid](https://www.starwars.com/databank/super-battle-droid), [Droideka](https://www.starwars.com/databank/droideka), [commando droid](https://www.starwars.com/databank/commando-droid), [MagnaGuard background](https://www.starwars.com/news/10-of-the-deadliest-droids-in-star-wars), [T-series tactical droid](https://www.starwars.com/databank/t-series-tactical-droid), [Super Tactical Droids and Kalani](https://www.starwars.com/databank/super-tactical-droid), [dwarf spider droid](https://www.starwars.com/databank/dwarf-spider-droid), [LM-432 crab droid](https://www.starwars.com/databank/lm-432-muckraker-crab-droid), [Octuptarra droid](https://www.starwars.com/databank/octuptarra-droid).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3; recruit 4 through 11 in slot order. Fund each complete stage-0 loadout and the necessary roster/storage expansion before recruitment. Prioritise the full roster, then stage-1 equipment in slot order. No weapon refinement purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
